concept.intro: Our approach combines design, mobility and sustainability to offer premium modular homes capable of being installed anywhere.
concept.paragraph1: Williams Mobilhome develops housing solutions that respect environmental standards while offering modern comfort. Each model is designed to be lightweight, easy to transport and simple to assemble.
concept.paragraph2: Our mobile homes and modular units are designed for residential, leisure or mobile work uses. The concept is based on intelligent construction, quality materials and premium finishing.
concept.card1_desc: Optimized spaces, flexible layout and premium finishes that adapt to your needs.
concept.card2_desc: Structures designed for road transport, quick assembly and on-site installation without compromising on comfort.
concept.why1: Mobile and sustainable habitat, compatible with modern lifestyles.
concept.why3: Personalized support at every step, from model selection to delivery.

tech.intro: We use carefully selected materials to offer robustness, insulation and lightness in each model.
tech.materials_desc: Reinforced steel frame, aluminum structure and high-performance insulating panels guarantee a stable and durable structure while limiting weight for transport.
tech.isolation_p1: Thermal and acoustic insulation is optimized to maintain a comfortable temperature in all seasons and reduce external noise.
tech.isolation_p2: Our solutions include high-efficiency heating, ventilation and lighting systems.
tech.finish_desc: Each mobilhome is delivered with careful finishes, resistant coatings and equipment that is easy to maintain for long-lasting and hassle-free use.

faq.intro: Find answers to the most common questions about our modular homes, delivery and purchase terms.
faq.a1: We coordinate delivery directly to your site. The model is transported by truck, then installed with a dedicated team to ensure safe placement.
faq.q2: Do I need a building permit?
faq.a2: Depending on the size and type of dwelling, prior notification or a permit may be necessary. We support you through the administrative process.
faq.q3: What types of soil are compatible?
faq.a3: Our structures can be installed on prepared ground, concrete slab, piers or stabilized ground. A preliminary assessment validates the best configuration.
faq.a4: Yes, we offer layout options, colors and equipment to adapt each model to your personal or professional use.
faq.a5: Timeframes vary by model and specifications. Generally, manufacturing and preparation take several weeks before delivery.

privacy.intro: We only collect data necessary to process your requests, prepare your orders and improve your site experience.
privacy.data_desc: When you place an order or contact us, we collect information such as your name, email address, postal address and delivery coordinates.
privacy.purpose_desc: This data is used to process orders, manage deliveries, respond to customer requests and ensure administrative and commercial follow-up.
privacy.retention_desc: We keep your information only for the time necessary to manage your order and in compliance with legal obligations.
privacy.security_desc: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access.

terms.intro: By using our site, you accept our terms and conditions of sale, payment terms and service commitments.
terms.order_desc: Your order is confirmed upon payment confirmation. Delivery times are specified when ordering and may vary depending on destination.
terms.cancel_desc: Any cancellation must be requested promptly. Depending on production progress, fees may apply.
terms.liability_desc: Williams Mobilhome commits to providing conforming products. Liability is limited to obligations provided by consumer law and applicable regulations.
